text:
kelly (Sales Ops): Heads up — Altair Labs disputed the Apr invoice INV-2026-0419 for a large volume overage. They're asking for a 40% bulk credit on the overage. Sam looped me in. Need deal-desk approval and guidance on whether we can make a post-bill exception.
ajay (RevOps): Quick facts: committed 150M tokens for Q1–Q2. April had evaluation spike; overage = ~800k tokens. Raw overage charge = $240,000 (per invoice). They're asking 40% -> ~$96,000. Uploaded usage CSV and invoice extract to the ticket.
sam (Account Exec): Customer says if we don't provide a concession they may pause production. They referenced MSA but asked for a pragmatic fix. I can get them to sign an amendment if we offer a concession tied to a bumped commit.
maria (Finance): Need GL impact and revenue recognition check. Any credit > $50k needs senior finance approval. Also prefer to split impact across months if possible — provide exact credit amount and suggested journal entries.
kelly (Sales Ops): My proposal: offer 30% one-time concession (~$72,000) instead of 40%, conditional on them signing a 6-month committed bump and updated usage telemetry. That limits precedent while keeping customer. Thoughts?
derek (Legal): Contract review: MSA section 5.1 allows discretionary adjustments by mutual agreement. We can do a short amendment that documents the concession + commit. I'll draft an amendment template — need the exact numbers.
ajay (RevOps): Next steps checklist I'm tracking: 1) Confirm credit amount for approval 2) Legal amendment draft 3) Create NetSuite credit memo draft 4) Obtain finance approval for posting 5) Post once amendment signed. Created Jira BILL-4592 and attached calc.
maria (Finance): I can provisionally approve up to $75,000. If final concession <= $75k, finance will sign off and post. If it's > $75k need CFO secondary sign-off. Please aim for <= $75k.
kelly (Sales Ops): Thanks @maria. So we'll offer 30% ($72k) which fits under your limit. @sam can you confirm customer will accept 30% + amendment now? Also who will own the NetSuite posting?
sam (Account Exec): Customer verbally accepted 30% and the 6-month commit bump. I'll get the amendment signed today. @ajay can you draft the credit memo and route it for posting pending the signed amendment?
ajay (RevOps): On it — creating credit memo draft in NetSuite and linking to BILL-4592. Will mark status = Pending Amendment. Will also include suggested journal entry: Debit Revenue-Deferred, Credit Accounts Receivable (customer) for $72,000.
deals-bot: Automated: Deal desk route triggered for thread 1768888888. Required approvals outstanding: legal amendment signoff, final finance posting confirmation. Link: https://internal.redwood/desk/1768888888
maria (Finance): :thumbsup: Approving $72,000 concession pending upload of signed amendment and NetSuite credit memo. Finance will post in the current close period once docs are in.
kelly (Sales Ops): Great — thanks everyone. Closing criteria: NetSuite credit memo posted + signed amendment uploaded to BILL-4592. Sam will drop the signed doc here when back from customer call.
sam (Account Exec): Will update with signed amendment within the day.
kelly (Sales Ops): Thanks — tagging for visibility and audit trail.
